text: Affective interaction refers to establishing a good relationship foundation and stimulating the vitality and willingness of interaction. Including: 1) Create a good relationship atmosphere and eliminate the distance between enterprises; 2) Active expression of emotion (trust, commitment, etc.); 3) Partners’ recognition of the enterprise, the cooperation relationship, and the ability of both parties.
source_label: How enterprise interactions in innovation networks affect technological innovation performance: The role of technological innovation capacity and absorptive capacity
